title: Importing the native services capture must not silently discard recovery semantics

provenance.note: Anchored to the original genuine GPMC Services capture, whose literal wire values and omission behavior remain authoritative even though its reconstructed UI-intent note was not. The expected behavior is stated against Studio's public parse path (parse_gpp_services via the backup importer), which an operator actually runs; TestServicesConformance pins the corrected behavior locally.

authored_intent.operator_action: Import the committed WI01A-Services-GPMC backup through Studio's backup-import path and inspect the resulting services items.

expected_native.loss_policy: Every recovery attribute present in the capture must surface in the Studio model either as a typed field or as preserved unknown content that a later export re-emits. The observed 60000000 and 30000000 values are preserved as literal milliseconds; the original intent note, not these native bytes, was superseded by WI-024. A value that vanishes at parse time and is absent from any re-export is a silent drop and fails this scenario. Attributes GPMC itself omitted (Spooler thirdFailure, W32Time recovery set) must remain absent, not materialize as defaults on re-export.
